preferred_interpretation: The frozen CTC scorer retained meaningful addition-ranking evidence, but its score distributions shifted across speakers and addition/non-addition overlap remained substantial. Consequently, the TRAIN-derived global threshold did not transfer with adequate false-addition control.

evidence: continuous AUC remained useful while correct-only FAR increased from 0.03491295938104449 to 0.0832481079975455
5 of 6 VALIDATION speakers exceeded the historical correct-FAR reference
aggregate medians shifted upward by about 0.13 to 0.15 across major cohorts
VALIDATION AUCs of 0.7513 and 0.7717 show useful but incomplete separation
false positives occurred in correct-only, substitution, deletion, and mixed negative cohorts
positive and negative frozen-threshold margins overlapped broadly

forbidden_simplifications: threshold calibration failed was the only issue
